correctness.rationale: The support classification follows from nested neighborhoods: a maximal independent set must contain a prefix of the A-side and then exactly the B-tail beyond its last selected degree, with corners only where the degree jumps. For a fixed corner, the left and right blocking conditions depend on disjoint priority sets, hence factor. Conditioning on the earliest active vertex yields the terminating \(\Phi\) recurrence. An independent exhaustive reconstruction over every connected canonical chain graph with total order at most 7 matched the exact rational support and probabilities for every permutation.

evidence: Alecu et al. state that chain graphs have O(n) inclusion-wise maximal independent sets.
